description: Elastic Security SIEM alert rules — wstg-07-09

rules.name: SQL Injection Attack Detected
rules.description: Detects SQL injection patterns in HTTP requests including UNION SELECT, OR 1=1, and comment-based injection
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("input-validation" OR "sql-injection" OR "injection")

rules.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Reflected
rules.description: Detects reflected XSS patterns in HTTP request parameters including script tags and event handlers
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("input-validation" OR "xss" OR "reflected-xss")

rules.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Stored
rules.description: Detects stored XSS patterns where malicious scripts are persisted and served to other users
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("input-validation" OR "xss" OR "stored-xss")

rules.name: Command Injection Detection
rules.description: Detects OS command injection patterns including pipe, semicolon, backtick, and dollar-paren command substitution
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("input-validation" OR "command-injection" OR "injection")

rules.name: LDAP Injection Attack
rules.description: Detects LDAP injection patterns in authentication and search parameters using LDAP special characters
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("input-validation" OR "ldap-injection" OR "injection")

rules.name: XML External Entity (XXE) Injection
rules.description: Detects XXE attack patterns in XML request bodies including SYSTEM and PUBLIC external entity declarations
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("input-validation" OR "xxe" OR "injection")

rules.name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
rules.description: Detects SSRF attempts targeting internal networks, cloud metadata, and localhost services
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("input-validation" OR "ssrf" OR "server-side")

rules.name: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI)
rules.description: Detects template injection patterns including Jinja2, Twig, Freemarker, and Velocity expressions
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("input-validation" OR "ssti" OR "template-injection")

rules.name: NoSQL Injection Attack
rules.description: Detects NoSQL injection patterns including MongoDB $where, $regex, and $gt operators
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("input-validation" OR "nosql-injection" OR "injection")

rules.name: Insecure Deserialization Attack
rules.description: Detects insecure deserialization of Java, Python, PHP, and .NET serialized objects
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("input-validation" OR "deserialization" OR "injection")

rules.name: HTTP Parameter Pollution
rules.description: Detects HTTP parameter pollution attacks where duplicate parameters bypass validation
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("input-validation" OR "hpp" OR "parameter-pollution")

rules.name: File Upload Attack — Malicious File Type
rules.description: Detects upload of potentially malicious file types including webshells, executables, and script files
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("input-validation" OR "file-upload" OR "webshell")

rules.name: Host Header Injection
rules.description: Detects Host header injection attacks used for password reset poisoning, cache poisoning, and SSRF
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("input-validation" OR "host-header" OR "injection")

rules.name: GraphQL Injection and Introspection Abuse
rules.description: Detects GraphQL injection, excessive introspection queries, and depth-based DoS attacks
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("input-validation" OR "graphql" OR "injection")

rules.name: Buffer Overflow via HTTP Request
rules.description: Detects unusually long HTTP requests that may trigger buffer overflow vulnerabilities
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("input-validation" OR "buffer-overflow" OR "overflow")

rules.name: DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting
rules.description: Detects DOM-based XSS patterns where client-side JavaScript renders user input unsafely
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("client-side" OR "dom-xss" OR "xss")

rules.name: JavaScript Execution via eval or document.write
rules.description: Detects unsafe JavaScript patterns including eval(), document.write(), and innerHTML with untrusted input
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("client-side" OR "js-execution" OR "xss")

rules.name: Client-Side URL Redirect (Open Redirect)
rules.description: Detects open redirect vulnerabilities where client-side JavaScript redirects to untrusted URLs
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("client-side" OR "open-redirect" OR "url-redirect")

rules.name: CSS Injection via Style Attribute
rules.description: Detects CSS injection patterns through style attributes or CSS files that could exfiltrate data
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("client-side" OR "css-injection" OR "data-theft")

rules.name: PostMessage API Abuse — Wildcard Origin
rules.description: Detects PostMessage API usage with wildcard origins enabling cross-origin data theft
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("client-side" OR "postmessage" OR "cross-origin")

rules.name: Web Storage (localStorage/sessionStorage) Data Leakage
rules.description: Detects sensitive data stored in browser web storage accessible to XSS attacks
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("client-side" OR "web-storage" OR "data-exposure")

rules.name: Service Worker Registration Abuse
rules.description: Detects unauthorized service worker registration that could intercept network requests
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("client-side" OR "service-worker" OR "interception")

rules.name: CORS Wildcard Configuration
rules.description: Detects CORS configurations with wildcard origins or origin reflection enabling data theft
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("client-side" OR "cors" OR "misconfiguration")

rules.name: SSRF to Internal Services and Cloud Metadata
rules.description: Detects SSRF requests targeting internal services, localhost, and cloud metadata endpoints
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("server-side" OR "ssrf" OR "cloud-metadata")

rules.name: HTTP Request Smuggling
rules.description: Detects HTTP request smuggling via CL.TE or TE.CL content-length/transfer-encoding discrepancies
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("server-side" OR "request-smuggling" OR "http-protocol")

rules.name: Race Condition — Concurrent Request Exploitation
rules.description: Detects concurrent requests exploiting race conditions in financial or state-changing operations
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("server-side" OR "race-condition" OR "concurrency")

rules.name: File Inclusion (LFI/RFI)
rules.description: Detects local and remote file inclusion attacks via path traversal or URL inclusion
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("server-side" OR "file-inclusion" OR "lfi-rfi")

rules.name: Server-Side Code Injection
rules.description: Detects server-side code injection through eval, exec, system calls, and expression language abuse
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("server-side" OR "code-injection" OR "rce")

rules.name: Denial of Service via Resource Exhaustion
rules.description: Detects denial of service attacks through resource exhaustion including CPU, memory, and connection limits
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("server-side" OR "dos" OR "resource-exhaustion")

rules.name: Unsafe File Upload — Webshell
rules.description: Detects upload of webshell files (PHP, JSP, ASP) through file upload functionality
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("server-side" OR "file-upload" OR "webshell")

rules.name: Cryptography — Weak TLS Cipher Suite
rules.description: Detects negotiation of weak or deprecated TLS cipher suites during connection setup
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("cryptography" OR "weak-tls" OR "encryption")

rules.name: Cryptography — Hardcoded Encryption Keys
rules.description: Detects hardcoded encryption keys in source code or configuration files
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("cryptography" OR "hardcoded-keys" OR "encryption")
